rows.context_and_review_note: Retained Drawing area, the reviewed descriptive canvas term. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:76 identifies the CANVAS edit group. Free-state adɣar is appropriate as the standalone tab label; n ussunɣ is the drawing genitive. Refers to the document surface including blank pixels, not only painted marks or the screen viewport.

Retained Canvas size… with the attached-state udɣar after n and matching command ellipsis. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:851 calls dimensionsDialog(false,false), whose resize uses stretch=false. PaintDocument.kt:423–431 creates the new canvas and copies existing pixels at top-left without resampling; smaller dimensions clip, larger ones add background. The term size here does not mean file bytes, viewport zoom or proportional scaling of the artwork.

Retained the exact same noun phrase as the command without its ellipsis. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:1018 chooses this dialog title when fresh=false and stretch=false. The title names the document dimensions, not Fit in view. No invented constraints, resize guarantee or export action is introduced.

Retained Canvas edges/bounds. iran, the plural of iri, refers to boundary positions in this context; unlike trimming/removal wording it permits outward expansion as well as inward cropping. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:849 calls trimCanvas; PaintCanvas.kt:429–430 creates CropOverlay with allowOutside=true. PaintDocument.kt:439–450 changes actual document bounds, translating existing pixels relative to the new origin, clipping outside and filling newly exposed areas with background rather than scaling pixels.

Retained Apply bounds, consistent with the same edge noun and accepted Apply verb. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:1053 invokes applyTrim then exits the bounds controls. PaintCanvas.kt:432–434 calls document.changeCanvasBounds(crop.rect), clears the overlay and refits the view. Thus this applies document geometry; viewport refitting is subsequent, not the whole action. No file save, selection-only commit or stroke/outline drawing is implied.
